LifeOS v3.3.1 (Build 68):
• Premium Horizontal Card Stacking: Natural gesture-driven horizontal card stacks with subtle 3D perspective depth and fluid pagination across Nutrition meal slots, Shopping active lists & templates, Laundry batches, and Outings
• Seamless Detail Transitions: Integrated hero layout continuity between card stacks and detail views
• High-Efficiency Home Layout: Kept Home page in its pure high-speed 2x2 Bento grid
• Performance Hardening: 120fps Android WebView GPU composited animations strictly utilizing transforms and opacities
